STATUS: NO_ANSWER
The retrieved results do not give a QD threshold specific to indels. The only QD thresholds listed are a vendor default of QD < 2.0 [CF-QD:default] and a local SOP value of QD < 1.5 [CF-QD:local], and neither states a variant type. The local value is marked as an alternative. The bcftools filter documentation [bcftools_manual#h055] describes fixed-threshold filtering with -e/--exclude expressions but gives no QD value. Please check the official GATK documentation for indel-specific hard-filter values.
